files.entities.csv/json: One row/object per entity (7,487). Grades are carried per store and never merged.
files.relationships.csv/json: One row/object per relationship (7,947). evidenced_by names the store(s) attesting the edge.
files.conflicts.csv: Every preserved disagreement between the two stores (576 notes), labeled by class.
files.photos.csv: The per-image evidence record for each attached photograph (408): creator, source, license, credit line.

grade_scales.grade_master: Canonical CSV master scale: VERIFIED / STRONG EVIDENCE / UNVERIFIED.
grade_scales.grade_build: Build-graph scale under CTL-GOV-006: Verified = at least two independent sources including one authoritative; otherwise Provisional.

id_note: union_id (U-NNNNN) is the dataset id. master_ids and build_ids preserve each store’s own identifiers; the two stores’ CTL-E- strings are NOT interchangeable (221 known collisions) — cite the union_id.
